name: CHILDRENS_CROSSING_AHEAD_45_YELLOWGREEN_DIAMOND
legend: (arrow at 45 degrees, children on a crossing) (FYG)

sa_w6-5-2_children_crossing_l.desc: arrow up-left + children on crossing (upper diamond)

sa_w6-5-2_children_crossing_r.desc: arrow up-right + children on crossing (lower diamond)

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W6-5-2 (children's crossing ahead, 45 degrees): W6-5-2B illustrated (A 600, C 900; PNG W6-5-2A.png). Diamond 750 side in its 1060.66 bounding square; pale fluorescent yellow-green as printed, R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). The sheet draws both hands — arrow up-left (upper diamond, dimensioned) and arrow up-right (lower diamond); the children walk the same way on both, so each hand is traced from its own diamond (not mirrored). Symbols from the sheet's filled artwork (PDF fills at 1000 dpi, traced): arrow (250 x 219 detail) above two children (400 high) on a dashed crossing.
